description: Keyword/fuzzy browse of parts and models (partial names, typos, model-plus-type words) when you do not have an exact part number or model slug. Use resolve_request instead for a vague repair need you will answer (it may ask one clarifying question). Use get_part instead for an exact OEM part number. Use get_model_parts instead when the model is already known. Matching order: a part number (case, dashes, spaces ignored) ranks first; "<model> <type word>" naming one model returns its documented parts (mode model_exact); an ambiguous model plus type word returns mode needs_clarification; a bare type word ("ram") lists parts of that type. Otherwise each word is a case-insensitive substring on model name/slug/board and part number/name/type/brand, sorted by words matched, with parts for the best-matching model first. Optional type keeps only that part type (case-insensitive), overrides a type word in query, and never filters models. A miss returns mode no_match or did_you_mean (never auto-applied) with fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility).

limit.description: Optional cap on each of the models and parts lists, 1 to 50; default 20.

query.description: Required free text (max 200 characters): a model name, an OEM part number, a part type or a mix, e.g. "ThinkPad T490 battery", "01FR025", "7K4PW" or "ram".

type.description: Optional part type, matched exactly but case-insensitively against part types listed by get_coverage, e.g. "Battery", "Screen", "Keyboard", "Power Adapter", "SSD", "Memory".

name: search_parts

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Search laptop parts
